title: Semantic landmarks
description: Create meaningful header, navigation, main, complementary and footer regions so assistive technologies can navigate an HTML page.
objectives: Choose native semantic regions instead of generic div wrappers
Ensure a single main landmark and descriptive navigation label
Name complementary content and preserve landmarks in the DOM
rubric: I used appropriate native landmarks and only one main region.
I verified that the skip link resolves to the intended main content.
I passed landmark-label and fragment-target checks.
